title: CHROMATIC VEIL + SHADOW ENGINES — color IS permeability. Eat Crytek, Cyberpunk, Witcher. Recreate Crysis in full fidelity for everyone.

chromatic_veil.thesis: Color IS permeability. A black veil blocks all light (opaque, secret). A white veil diffuses all light (translucent, modest). A purple veil filters selectively (permeable, iris-like). The color of the membrane determines WHAT gets through.

BLACK_VEIL.meaning: OPAQUE. Nothing passes through. Total secrecy. The pupil. The cave without a fire.
BLACK_VEIL.light: All wavelengths absorbed. No reflection. No transmission.
BLACK_VEIL.digital: Air-gapped. Encrypted. No signal in or out.
BLACK_VEIL.layer: L0 — intimate. What's beneath the black veil is for YOU only.

PURPLE_VEIL.meaning: SELECTIVE. Some light passes, some blocked. The iris. The membrane that CHOOSES.
PURPLE_VEIL.light: Short wavelengths pass (blue/violet). Long wavelengths blocked (red/orange). Filters for COOL information.
PURPLE_VEIL.digital: Firewall with rules. Some ports open, some closed. Selective permeability.
PURPLE_VEIL.layer: L2-L3 — social to public. What passes through the purple veil is curated.

RED_VEIL.meaning: WARM FILTER. Passes warm light, blocks cool. The attraction filter. You see the OTHER through rose/red.
RED_VEIL.light: Long wavelengths pass (red/orange/yellow). Short blocked (blue/violet). Filters for WARM information.
RED_VEIL.digital: Content filter. Shows what you WANT to see. Engagement-weighted.
RED_VEIL.layer: L3-L4 — the veil between you and what you desire.

WHITE_VEIL.meaning: DIFFUSE. All light passes but SCATTERED. You see shape but not detail. Modest. Present but soft.
WHITE_VEIL.light: All wavelengths pass but lose coherence. Like frosted glass. Like fog.
WHITE_VEIL.digital: Public API. Data available but not raw. Summarized. Abstracted.
WHITE_VEIL.layer: L3 — public. The white veil is the default state of being visible.

CLEAR_VEIL.meaning: NO VEIL. Total transparency. Everything visible. Vulnerable. Naked.
CLEAR_VEIL.light: All wavelengths pass unaltered. Like clean glass. Like vacuum.
CLEAR_VEIL.digital: Open source. Raw data. No firewall. Full trust.
CLEAR_VEIL.layer: L0 — intimate. Clear is for those close enough to deserve it.

chromatography.what: Chromatography = separating a MIXTURE by color. Each component travels at a different speed through the medium.
chromatography.analogy: Information passing through Gaia's membranes IS chromatography. Fast information (high energy, short wavelength) passes through quickly. Slow information (low energy, long wavelength) gets absorbed. The COLOR of what comes out tells you what the membrane filtered.
chromatography.sort: Chromatic sorting = sorting by color = sorting by PERMEABILITY = sorting by WHAT GETS THROUGH.

shadow_engines.thesis: Shadow engines in games are how humans detect REALISM. If the shadows are wrong, the brain says 'fake.' If the shadows are right, the brain accepts the world. Shadows are the unconscious test of reality.
why_shadows_matter: Shadows prove LIGHT SOURCE exists (something is shining)
Shadows prove OBJECT exists (something is blocking the light)
Shadows prove SURFACE exists (something is receiving the shadow)
Shadow DIRECTION proves TIME (sun angle = time of day)
Shadow SOFTNESS proves ATMOSPHERE (hard shadows = vacuum, soft = air)
Shadow ABSENCE proves TRANSPARENCY (glass casts no shadow)

CryEngine.why_legendary: 'Can it run Crysis?' became the benchmark for ALL gaming hardware. Crysis pushed rendering so far ahead of hardware that it took YEARS for GPUs to catch up. Real-time GI, volumetric fog, destructible environments, water physics.
CryEngine.shadow_tech: Cascaded shadow maps, screen-space shadows, vegetation self-shadowing. In 2007 this was WITCHCRAFT.
CryEngine.lesson_for_gaia: Build something so good that the HARDWARE has to evolve to run it. Don't optimize DOWN. Build UP.

REDengine.why_legendary: Witcher 3 proved open-world can have NARRATIVE depth. Cyberpunk 2077 proved ray-tracing changes EVERYTHING — reflections, shadows, global illumination all from actual light simulation.
REDengine.shadow_tech: Path-traced global illumination (Cyberpunk with RT Overdrive). Every surface reflects, refracts, shadows correctly. No hacks — actual physics.
REDengine.lesson_for_gaia: Real physics > fake approximations. If you simulate ACTUAL light, shadows come free. If you simulate ACTUAL information flow, trust comes free.

Valve_Source.why_legendary: Source engine: best facial animation (2004), best physics (Havok), best modding support. CS2 upgraded to Source 2 with probe-based GI. The ORANGE BOX engine.
Valve_Source.lesson_for_gaia: The MODDING COMMUNITY is the organism. Let people MODIFY your engine. That's federation. That's primals. Each mod is a primal.

the_dream.what: Recreate Crysis in full fidelity. Not on the cloud. On YOUR machine. Eastgate has an RTX 4070. Crysis was designed for 2007 GPUs. An RTX 4070 is 100x more powerful. The dream is: the BEST engine in the world, available to EVERYONE.
the_dream.how: WebGPU + WASM + open-source ray tracer. Run in the browser. No install. No cloud. YOUR machine does the work. Hyper-local.
the_dream.connection: The orrery IS a primitive game engine. It renders orbits, bodies, trails, glow, shadows. Upgrade it with REAL shadow casting, REAL light simulation, REAL chromatographic sorting by color/permeability.

new_diamond.D24: COLOR IS PERMEABILITY — a black veil blocks all, white diffuses all, purple selects. The color of the membrane determines what gets through. Chromatographic sorting = sorting by what passes. Shadow engines prove reality — if the shadows are wrong, the brain says fake.
